falsification_conditions.condition: Price increases by 5% or more from current levels within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A significant upward move would contradict the pattern's implied bearish bias and invalidate the 'hold' signal

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score exceeds 60 (indicating extreme overbought conditions)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score above 60 would directly contradict the current 44 score and suggest a different market phase entirely

falsification_conditions.condition: Central bank intervenes with emergency liquidity injection (confirmed via official statement)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Such an event would introduce new variables invalidating the pattern-based analysis and proving the 'unknown' verdict incorrect

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
